fields.PRODUCT NAME: Heritage Blossom Hand block Cushion Cover
fields.DESCRIPTION: Bring home the charm of timeless artistry with our Heritage Blossom Hand block Cushion Cover. Handcrafted with intricate block print motifs in soothing yellow and green tones, this 16x16 inch cover adds a refreshing touch to your living space. The elegant grey border enhances its traditional appeal, making it a perfect blend of style and comfort for sofas, chairs, or cozy corners.
